value.rationale: The joint (dim radical,dim socle) count is a canonical and naturally necessary distribution for all representations of a square-zero local algebra. This exact finite-field refinement extends beyond geometric support classification, works for arbitrarily many loops, includes wild-type families, and yields a uniform arithmetical duality and a quantitative parity transition. It is a complete natural invariant, not a small unmotivated numerical slice; prior geometric existence results are explicitly credited.
